description: Enrolled OS-PLANES for the Actor Corroboration Grid (ADR-0068 corrects ADR-0017). A plane is the OS the extension RUNS in; a genuinely independent (cross-plane) quorum must span BOTH planes (linux AND windows). The hypervisor/context that provisions a plane (VirtualBox, VMware, Codespace, native) is a recorded attribute, NOT a separate plane -- N linux contexts (a codespace + a vbox guest + a native host) are ONE linux plane, not N independent witnesses.

planes.description: The Linux plane -- the extension runs on Linux (e.g. a VirtualBox Ubuntu guest, a VMware Ubuntu guest, a GitHub Codespace, or a native Linux host).
The Windows plane -- the extension runs on Windows (e.g. a VirtualBox or VMware Windows guest, or a native Windows host).
